projectDescription: Screening is independent film infrastructure that lets filmmakers run ticketed premiere nights — virtual, in-person, or hybrid — and keep their audience and revenue directly through Stripe Connect.
keyFeatures: Hybrid screening nights — sell tickets for in-person, online, or both simultaneously
Stripe Connect Express payouts — filmmakers are the merchant of record; buyers pay them directly
Timed live-stream gate — one concurrent session per ticket email, short-lived signed Mux playback
On-demand rent or buy — same rails as a live night, available after the premiere window
Web door check-in — scan or search ticket codes; QR codes in confirmation emails
Studio CMS — draft → publish → cancel lifecycle with rights attestation and publish checklist
Ticket tiers and capacity — Standard and Concession tiers, venue fields for in-person events
Interest and waitlist pages — gauge demand and collect pre-orders before going on sale
Discover feed — public listing of upcoming nights; buyers can follow organisations
Automated email — ticket confirmations, 24h and 1h reminders, postpone and cancel notices
Team roles — owner, admin, editor, viewer, and door staff per organisation
Platform fee 5% + 30p all-in — card processing absorbed; no monthly subscription for Free tier
publicApiSurface: POST /api/v1/auth/token — email/password sign-in, mint scoped device token pair
POST /api/v1/auth/exchange — mint short-lived JWT (~15 min) from refresh token or cookie session
GET /api/v1/auth/devices — list active devices for the signed-in session
POST /api/v1/auth/revoke-all — revoke all device tokens for the signed-in user
GET|PATCH|DELETE /api/v1/host/films/:id — read, update, delete a film
GET|PATCH|DELETE /api/v1/host/screenings/:id — read, update, delete a screening
GET|POST /api/v1/host/door/check-in — fetch and submit ticket check-ins
GET /api/v1/host/connect/status — Stripe Connect readiness for the organisation
GET /api/v1/watcher/discover — paginated public screening discovery feed
GET /api/v1/watcher/booth/:orgSlug/:screeningSlug — public booth metadata for a screening
POST /api/v1/watcher/access — verify ticket and establish live-stream session
POST /api/v1/watcher/stream — return signed Mux playback frame URL
GET /api/v1/watcher/me — current watcher user profile and capabilities
GET /api/v1/watcher/checkout/return — post-payment return and ticket fulfillment
